sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Section Two Signals

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: FXsec02R01
After a full stop and yielding to pedestrians and other traffic, a right turn on red is permitted unless a No Turn on Red sign or rightward red arrow prohibits it. A left turn on red requires a one-way street leading onto another one-way street, the same stop and yield, and no prohibiting sign or leftward red arrow [FXsec02R01].
Why it matters: group signal-meanings; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F04, sec02-F06 [FXsec02R01].
Source: [FXsec02R01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: FXsec02R02
A steady red arrow requires waiting unless a posted sign specifically permits that turn after stopping. A flashing red arrow requires a full stop and yielding to opposing vehicles and pedestrians; proceed in its direction only when clear [FXsec02R02].
Why it matters: group signal-meanings; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F07, sec02-F10 [FXsec02R02].
Source: [FXsec02R02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: FXsec02R03
At a steady yellow light or arrow, stop before entering if you can do so safely. If stopping is unsafe or you are already inside, continue carefully without accelerating to beat the signal. A flashing yellow means reduce speed and proceed carefully [FXsec02R03].
Why it matters: group signal-meanings; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F11, sec02-F12 [FXsec02R03].
Source: [FXsec02R03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A01
Flashing red demands a full stop plus a yield before going, while flashing yellow demands no stop at all [A01].
Why it matters: group signal-meanings; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F09, sec02-F12 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: FXsec02R05
At steady red, make a full stop and wait while red continues, except for a permitted turn. At flashing red, stop fully, yield to approaching vehicles and pedestrians, and continue only after the path is clear [FXsec02R05].
Why it matters: group signal-meanings; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F03, sec02-F09 [FXsec02R05].
Source: [FXsec02R05 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A02
A red X bans its lane entirely, a yellow X orders a safe exit from the lane, and a green arrow opens the lane [A02].
Why it matters: group lane-signals; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F16, sec02-F17, sec02-F18 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A02
Turning on a plain green light without an arrow means yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians, while a green arrow in your direction means going when clear [A02].
Why it matters: group signal-meanings; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F14 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A02
Solid double reds on a pedestrian beacon hold drivers stopped with walkers crossing, while the later alternating flashing reds release drivers with caution once the crosswalk clears [A02].
Why it matters: group lane-signals; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec02-F19 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A02
The eight-sided octagon always commands a full stop, while the triangle commands only slowing with a stop as needed [A02].
Why it matters: group sign-language; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F23, sec02-F24 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A02
Black with white states a law to obey, yellow with black warns of a hazard, and red with white orders stop, yield, or no [A02].
Why it matters: group sign-language; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F21 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A02
Orange with black warns through construction zones, while pink with black warns at incidents [A02].
Why it matters: group sign-language; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F22 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]
